mapper.select: SELECT u.userId, u.userName, u.userRole, u.phone FROM GUARDIAN_LINKS gl INNER JOIN USERS u ON u.userId = gl.userId WHERE gl.guardianId = #{guardianId}

SELECT t.tripId, t.tripStatus, t.startDt, r.startName, r.endName, r.totalDuration, (SELECT s.checkpointName FROM ROUTE_STEPS s WHERE s.routeId = t.routeId AND s.checkpointName IS NOT NULL AND s.stepOrder >= COALESCE((SELECT cur.stepOrder FROM ROUTE_STEPS cur WHERE cur.routeStepId = t.currentStepId), 0) ORDER BY s.stepOrder LIMIT 1) AS nextCheckpointName, (SELECT s.distance FROM ROUTE_STEPS s WHERE s.routeId = t.routeId AND s.checkpointName IS NOT NULL AND s.stepOrder >= COALESCE((SELECT cur.stepOrder FROM ROUTE_STEPS cur WHERE cur.routeStepId = t.currentStepId), 0) ORDER BY s.stepOrder LIMIT 1) AS nextCheckpointDistance FROM TRIPS t INNER JOIN ROUTES r ON r.routeId = t.routeId WHERE r.userId = #{userId} AND t.tripStatus = 'MOVING' ORDER BY t.startDt DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT tripLocationId, tripId, lat, lng, regDt FROM TRIP_LOCATIONS WHERE tripId = #{tripId} ORDER BY regDt DESC, tripLocationId DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT notificationId, receiverId, tripEventId, notifyType, content, readYn, regDt FROM NOTIFICATIONS WHERE receiverId = #{receiverId} ORDER BY regDt DESC, notificationId DESC LIMIT #{listSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTIFICATIONS WHERE receiverId = #{receiverId} AND readYn = 'N'

SELECT n.notificationId, n.notifyType, n.content, n.readYn, n.regDt, COALESCE(e.lat, CAST(h.currentLatitude AS DECIMAL(10, 7))) AS lat, COALESCE(e.lng, CAST(h.currentLongitude AS DECIMAL(10, 7))) AS lng, COALESCE(e.eventDt, h.regDt) AS eventDt,
COALESCE( NULLIF(r.endName, ''), NULLIF(h.destinationName, ''), (SELECT r2.endName FROM TRIPS t2 INNER JOIN ROUTES r2 ON r2.routeId = t2.routeId WHERE r2.userId = h.userId AND t2.startDt <= h.regDt AND (t2.endDt IS NULL OR t2.endDt >= h.regDt) ORDER BY t2.startDt DESC LIMIT 1) ) AS destination FROM NOTIFICATIONS n LEFT JOIN TRIP_EVENTS e ON e.tripEventId = n.tripEventId LEFT JOIN TRIPS t ON t.tripId = e.tripId LEFT JOIN ROUTES r ON r.routeId = t.routeId LEFT JOIN HELP_REQUEST h ON h.helpRequestId = n.helpRequestId WHERE n.notificationId = #{notificationId} AND n.receiverId = #{receiverId}
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTIFICATIONS SET readYn = 'Y' WHERE receiverId = #{receiverId} AND readYn = 'N'
